slices.focus: Saira and Tom finally book a small registry-office wedding after months of postponement
slices.summary: After the long postponement and repetitive arguments, Saira and Tom book a small registry-office wedding for early summer with a family meal after. They define three non-negotiables: small ceremony, family meal not full reception, no borrowing money. The decision improves their relationship tone noticeably.
